title_zh: Science and technology — 第20节可背诵讲义
body_en: Phones and computers are tools, not teachers. Use them to look up a word, then close the screen and practice. Build a small project: a poster, a model, or a short talk about one invention. Team work matters: one plans, one builds, one checks. Technology serves learning when you stay in control.
body_zh: 手机和电脑是工具，不是老师。用它们查一个词，然后关掉屏幕去练习。做一个小项目：海报、模型，或关于一项发明的短演讲。团队合作重要：一人计划、一人制作、一人检查。当你掌控节奏，科技才服务学习。
